title: Q-LESSON-SILENT-CATCH: Lint catch blocks that only log
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:test/plan-limits.test.mjs::SILENT-CATCH
**Status:** closed

LESSONS-1 (2026-11-16): from the failure-mode register of the fleet this org was split from (638 entries, classified by root cause).

35 failure modes were silent drops: empty catches and 'ok' answers for failed sends hid failures.

Path: test/plan-limits.test.mjs

Acceptance: a test fails when a catch block in seed/worker/src has an empty body or only console.* calls, unless it carries an allow-silent comment with a reason; existing ones are listed in a shrink-only baseline.

size: S

**Closing probe:** grep:test/plan-limits.test.mjs::SILENT-CATCH

**Evidence:** test/plan-limits.test.mjs 'SILENT-CATCH' fails on a catch block in seed/worker/src/*.js with an empty or console.*-only body and no `allow-silent:` reason; shrink-only baseline {pulse.js: 2, tick.js: 1}. cutover.js copy() lost the error of every schema object it could not recreate (the comment said 'recorded below', nothing was); it now returns them in `skipped`, which reaches the cutover notes.
